.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:.75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:72px;align-items:center}
.intro-image{position:relative;min-height:660px}
.intro-image .main-img{width:87%;height:620px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:180px 180px 24px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.intro-image .mini-img{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:43%;height:280px;object-fit:cover;border:10px solid var(--paper2);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.year-card{position:absolute;left:-12px;bottom:45px;background:var(--forest);color:white;width:166px;height:166px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(28,65,53,.27)}
.year-card b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1}
.year-card span{font-size:.65rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em}
.intro-copy .lede{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.4vw,2.15rem);line-height:1.36;margin:28px 0;color:#2a3935}
.intro-copy .body{color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.location-mark{margin-top:34px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.location-dot{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#efe1d4;color:var(--sun)}

.highlights{background:var(--ink);color:white;overflow:hidden}
.highlights-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:42px}
.highlights h2{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4.5vw,4.3rem)}
.highlights p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);max-width:500px}
.feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.feature{min-height:180px;padding:26px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);position:relative}
.feature svg{width:28px;height:28px;margin-bottom:38px;stroke:#ffc48a;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5}
.feature h3{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.98rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em}
.feature small{display:block;color:rgba(255,255,255,.58);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5}

/* Accommodation */
.stay-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.86fr 1.14fr;gap:70px;align-items:start}
.stay-copy{position:sticky;top:130px}
.stay-copy h2{max-width:620px}
.stay-copy p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:24px;max-width:540px}
.stay-copy .btn{margin-top:30px}
.stay-collage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:320px;gap:14px}
.stay-collage figure{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;background:#ddd}
.stay-collage figure:nth-child(1){grid-row:span 2}
.stay-collage img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.6s}
.stay-collage figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.caption-chip{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;background:rgba(255,250,242,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);padding:9px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* Split experience */
.experience-banner{position:relative;min-height:670px;display:grid;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:var(--forest);color:white}
.experience-banner:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(12,30,24,.90),rgba(12,30,24,.58) 45%,rgba(12,30,24,.08)),url('data:image/webp;base64,') center/cover no-repeat}
.experience-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:90px 0;max-width:660px}
.experience-content h2{font-size:clamp(3rem,6vw,6rem)}
.experience-content p{margin-top:24px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.77);font-size:1.08rem}
.pill-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:30px}
.pill{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:.77rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}

/* Events */
.events{background:var(--paper)}
.events-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.event-main,.event-side{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;min-height:640px}
.event-main img,.event-side img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.event-main .event-card{position:absolute;left:24px;right:24px;bottom:24px;background:rgba(16,25,23,.86);color:white;padding:30px;border-radius:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.event-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);margin-top:10px}
.event-side{display:grid;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;background:none;overflow:visible}
.event-side figure{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;min-height:300px}
.event-side figure img{position:absolute;inset:0}
.event-side figure span{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;background:var(--paper2);padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hall-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:17px}
.hall-row span{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem}
.event-options{margin-top:40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.event-option{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px;border-radius:18px}
.event-option b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:6px}
.event-option span{font-size:.83rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* Dining */
.dining-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:70px;align-items:center}
.dining-photo{position:relative}
.dining-photo .big{height:650px;width:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:26px}
.dining-photo .small{position:absolute;width:44%;height:250px;right:-35px;bottom:-32px;object-fit:cover;border:10px solid var(--paper2);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.dining-copy p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:24px;max-width:540px}
.menu-lines{margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.menu-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.87rem}
.menu-line b{font-weight:800} .menu-line span{color:var(--muted);text-align:right}

/* Gallery */
.gallery{background:#fff}
.gallery-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:34px}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.filter-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:white;padding:9px 14px;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
.filter-btn.is-active{background:var(--ink);color:white}
.gallery-grid{columns:4 250px;column-gap:12px}
.gallery-tile{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:#eee;margin:0 0 12px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;break-inside:avoid}
.gallery-tile img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:.45s}
.gallery-tile span{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;background:rgba(255,250,242,.9);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px);transition:.25s}
.gallery-tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.gallery-tile:hover span{opacity:1;transform:none}
.gallery-tile.is-hidden{display:none}

/* Story */
.story{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ocean);color:white}
.story:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-90px;top:-120px;width:420px;height:420px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 80px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 0 0 160px rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;gap:80px;align-items:start;position:relative;z-index:2}
.story-number{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(5rem,12vw,11rem);line-height:.78;color:#f4c58c;letter-spacing:-.06em}
.story-copy h2{max-width:760px}
.story-copy p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-size:1.05rem;max-width:700px;margin-top:24px}
.story-quote{margin-top:32px;padding-left:24px;border-left:2px solid #f4c58c;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1.45;max-width:700px}

/* Enquiry */
.enquiry{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f7efe4,#fffaf2)}
